profile.headline: Software Developer at Nexagen Networks, Inc.
profile.summary:
Professional Experience on resume. 
Professional Goals: To grow and gain as much experience in my prospective field.

positions.title: Power Generation Equipment Repairman
positions.description:
Performed preventive and corrective maintenance on tactical utility, precise power
   Generation sets, and internal combustion engines and associated equipment.
 Operated standard electrical and electronic test equipment.
 Maintained and repaired motors, switchboards, generators, and control equipment during                 
                                     Iraqi Freedom I and II.
 Supervised, trained and licensed over 100 soldiers on generation and electrical equipment.

positions.title: Heavy-Wheel Vehicle Mechanic
positions.description:
Maintained and accounted for military vehicles valued in the millions.
 Performed scheduled and unscheduled maintenance support on vehicles.
 Operated the HEMTT wrecker performing numerous recovery missions.
 Troubleshoot problems in vehicle engines, electrical systems, steering, brakes and 
                                      suspension.
  Repaired and replaced damage body sections on vehicles.

positions.title: Production Controller
positions.description:
•	Plans and schedules maintenance on all military equipment.
•	   Ensures that Army Materiel Status System (AMSS) equipment readiness reports are correct.
•	   Manages funding for supply and vehicles.

positions.title: Warehouse Clerk
positions.description:
Load and unload pharmaceuticals.
 Operated a forklift.
  Distribute pharmaceuticals to designated drivers.
 Keep an accurate count of merchandise and materials received and shipped.

positions.title: Technician
positions.description:
Provided corrective maintenance to vehicles.
 Installed parts to vehicles two tons and above in weight.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Information Technology; Software Systems Engineering and Web Development
